title: The Starblade Quest
moral: True bravery comes from facing your fears.

scenes.summary: Cedric is chosen to find a powerful sword.
scenes.text: Cedric is tasked with finding the Celestial Sword to save his kingdom.

scenes.summary: He faces doubt and fear during the journey.
scenes.text: He travels through the enchanted forest where magical creatures test him.

scenes.summary: Cedric overcomes trials and defeats a beast.
scenes.text: He faces a powerful creature and proves his courage through battle.

scenes.summary: He finds the sword and gains power.
scenes.text: Inside a magical cave, Cedric claims the Celestial Sword after proving his worth.

story: Sir Cedric is chosen to find the Celestial Sword to protect his kingdom. Along the way, he faces magical challenges and defeats a dangerous creature, proving his bravery. He discovers that true strength comes from overcoming fear. After obtaining the sword, he returns home and leads his people to victory against a powerful enemy.
